# Overview

NSDUH unmatched and matched main models (8).

This is one of five split reports for De Young et al., "Graduate school confers
risk for mental illness and suicide." The report bodies share a common renderer
(`_report_body.Rmd`); only the set of models differs between files.

```{r define-models, include=FALSE}

POSTERIOR_OUTPUTS <- "C:/Users/Jonas Dora/OneDrive - UW/studies/2026_shackman/grad_mh/data/OUTPUTS"
rds_model <- function(label, filename) list(name = label, path = file.path(POSTERIOR_OUTPUTS, paste0(filename, ".rds")), format = "rds")
rdata_model <- function(label, filename) list(name = label, path = file.path(POSTERIOR_OUTPUTS, paste0(filename, ".RData")), format = "RData")

models_to_report <- list(
  rdata_model("NSDUH: Any MI", "nsduh_anymi_12mos"),
  rdata_model("NSDUH: Global Health Dich", "nsduh_global_health_dich"),
  rdata_model("NSDUH: Suicidal Thinking", "nsduh_suic_thnk_12mos"),
  rdata_model("NSDUH: Suicide Attempt Linear", "nsduh_suic_try_12mos_linear"),
  rdata_model("NSDUH Matched: Any MI", "nsduh_matched_anymi_12mos"),
  rdata_model("NSDUH Matched: Global Health Dich", "nsduh_matched_global_health_dich"),
  rdata_model("NSDUH Matched: Suicidal Thinking", "nsduh_matched_suic_thnk_12mos"),
  rdata_model("NSDUH Matched: Suicide Attempt Linear", "nsduh_matched_suic_try_12mos_linear")
)
```

```{r child = "_report_body.Rmd"}
```
